Just as For All Mankind wrapped its latest season on Apple TV, the platform also premiered the first two episodes of Star City, a spinoff set in the same alternate timeline where the Soviet Union beats the United States to the Moon. Watch the trailer below.

Star City premieres on Apple TV

More than two years after it was first announced, Star City debuted on Apple TV, with its first two episodes now available to stream.

The show’s premise is interesting: it revisits the same alternate history as For All Mankind, but from the perspective of the Soviet Union and its space program.

In For All Mankind, the Soviet Union beats the United States to the Moon, setting off an alternate version of the space race that unfolds across major time jumps between most seasons.

Just a few days ago, the first reviews of Star City came in, with critics describing it as a darker, more espionage-driven companion to For All Mankind rather than a straightforward retelling from the other side. Reviews were also predominantly positive, which is always a plus.
